name: roll quadriceps (vastus lateralis) lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer thigh. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.
Place the roller under the outer thigh and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll from the hip down to above the knee.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
